# `max_by`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
max_by(x, y)
```

Returns the value of `x` associated with the maximum value of `y`.
max_by(x, y, k) - Returns an array of the `k` values of `x` associated with the
maximum values of `y`, sorted in descending order by `y`.
Returns NULL if there are no non-NULL ordering values.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- max_by, example 1
> SELECT max_by(x, y) FROM VALUES ('a', 10), ('b', 50), ('c', 20) AS tab(x, y);
b
```

```sql
-- max_by, example 2
> SELECT max_by(x, y, 2) FROM VALUES ('a', 10), ('b', 50), ('c', 20) AS tab(x, y);
["b","c"]
```
